truebeam-m120.description: Varian TrueBeam / Clinac, Millennium 120 MLC (60 pairs: 10 x 10 mm, 40 x 5 mm, 10 x 10 mm)
truebeam-m120.source: Leaf boundaries read from the author's TrueBeam DICOM RT plans (-200 to +200 mm).

truebeam-hd120.description: Varian TrueBeam STx / Edge, HD120 MLC (60 pairs: 14 x 5 mm, 32 x 2.5 mm, 14 x 5 mm)
truebeam-hd120.source: Central 32 pairs 2.5 mm, outer 28 pairs 5 mm projected at isocenter, 22 cm span (e.g. PMC7807868).
truebeam-hd120.notes: Derived plans were not delivered by the author. Check every aperture in your TPS.

varian-ethos-halcyon.description: Varian Ethos / Halcyon, dual-layer MLC (MLCX1 28 x 10 mm, MLCX2 29 x 10 mm, offset by half a leaf), no jaws
varian-ethos-halcyon.source: Leaf boundaries, parking positions and fixed jaw values read from the author's Ethos DICOM RT plan.
varian-ethos-halcyon.notes: A native Ethos daily QA plan with AM W-L is provided in rt_plans/Ethos; prefer it over conversion.

elekta-agility.description: Elekta Versa HD / Infinity / Harmony, Agility MLC (80 pairs x 5 mm)
elekta-agility.source: 160 leaves, 5 mm at isocenter, 40 x 40 cm maximum field (Elekta, 2012).
elekta-agility.notes: Not delivered by the author. Device types written by your TPS may differ; prefer --template with a plan exported from your own TPS.

elekta-mlci2.description: Elekta Synergy, MLCi2 (40 pairs x 10 mm)
elekta-mlci2.source: 40 leaf pairs, 10 mm at isocenter (vendor specification); not independently confirmed here.
elekta-mlci2.notes: Not delivered by the author. 2 x 2 cm apertures are coarse with 10 mm leaves; prefer --template.

varian-accela.notes: Use --template with any plan exported for your machine, and open an issue with the leaf boundaries so a profile can be added.
